items.title: Deere Has More Than Doubled Its Dividend Since 2020, but the Raises Have Stopped
items.summary: Deere has never suspended its payout, and it still cuts buybacks first when farm incomes sag. But the dividend has sat frozen for over a year, and one executive's bold call on the cycle will decide whether it moves again.

items.title: Cathie Wood and 3 Other Big Funds Sold Deere Last Quarter. Should You Follow Them Before Earnings?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCathie Wood’s ARK Invest and three other funds cut their Deere stakes in the third quarter, by between 31% and 98% of their shares. Deere’s business looks past its low point, but the stock already prices in the recovery, so trimming makes sense.
